travel.headline: Check Official Signage for Wildlife Protection and Closures
travel.reservation: Access to the Norfolk Coast is generally open, but specific seasonal restrictions apply to protect nesting birds and resting seals. Some National Nature Reserves may have cordoned areas or designated route requirements; always check current local signage for specific wildlife exclusion zones before entering dunes or beaches.

intel.text: Allow extra time for wildlife viewing at Blakeney Point. Always steer clear of cordons marked for protected species.

intel.title: Trail Restrictions
intel.text: Cycling is strictly prohibited on the Norfolk Coast Path but allowed on Peddars Way. Check for dog restrictions before entering nature reserves.

plan.arrival: Pick up a rental vehicle in Norwich or King's Lynn. Check into local brick and flint villages such as those near Cley or Winterton to settle into the historic landscape.
